info.title: MediCore Clinical Hospital REST API
info.description: Synthetic educational hospital operations API. PostgreSQL is authoritative. All clinical, billing, consent and FHIR endpoints enforce authentication and resource scope. Administrators have operational access and cannot read clinical charts. EMAIL/SMS and payments are local simulators.
